notes: Peak/off-peak split is the vendor's own. Off-peak = half of peak. The page lists deepseek-flash and deepseek-v4-pro columns.

The page names the flash model 'deepseek-flash'. 'deepseek-v4-flash' is a legacy name that is still accepted: requests are served by DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash and billed at the Flash price (page footnote 1, checked 2026-10-09). This repo's code-constant allowlist stays deepseek-v4-flash / deepseek-v4-pro (P2_DESIGN section 4), so the flash price is keyed under deepseek-v4-flash and canonical_id records the vendor's current name.
Chinese public holidays are off-peak all day on the vendor side. They are not computed here (excluded_dates is empty), so costs on those days are over-estimated, never under-estimated.
Thinking mode is on by default at effort high on the vendor side; reasoning tokens are billed as output tokens.

peak_hours_utc.rule_text: Peak hours are 01:00 - 04:00 and 06:00 - 10:00 UTC, Monday through Friday, excluding Chinese public holidays. All other hours are off-peak, including weekends and Chinese public holidays in full.
